findings.fact: Authenticated request staging writes only runtime _t keys using nvram_set_temp; request OFF clears temporary state.
Commit verifies current request/network/filter/OPEN identity, commits DNS and suspends RAM snapshot; it does not save persistent requested credentials/enable.
Owned rollback snapshot contains nine runtime _t keys, not persistent saved IoT profile.
Cold reservation reads saved wr_iot_enable/ssid/psk. Factory fallback is CSPRNG boot-profile-only and explicitly prohibits runtime ON from it.
Reboot activation reads saved requested configuration; runtime request success alone does not prove those values persist.
Classic only installs a pending page; authenticated Apply and activation are marked false.
Standard firmware step explicitly refuses RC wr-iot directory before make; paired runtime is isolated optional output.

decision: Do not activate Classic submit UI or main-image promotion before owned saved-configuration path is implemented
Reuse existing configuration and RC ownership; no direct HTTP NVRAM setter or duplicate writer
Distinguish queue acceptance, applied runtime state, saved configuration, flash save and observed restart state
Credential provisioning must respect loaded-profile identity; ordinary IoT ON/OFF must not restart or scan physical Wi-Fi
scope_limits: Source audit of named committed modules; not proof that no external/native SDK writer exists
No firmware protocol, runtime state, radio configuration or device changed
No new Classic page or Modern development performed
